board: SparkFun Weather Meter Kit SEN-15901 cup anemometer (reed switch on RJ11 pins 2 and 3 of the cable shared with the wind vane)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test reading 30 km/h = 12.5 closures/s, PCB DRC).
